title: REPLAY: US Secretary of State Rubio holds press conference after G7 meeting
summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio talked to the press Tuesday as the G7 meets in Paris. He said he saw no need to resume major combat operations against Iran because economic restrictions were working so effectively.
